name: Everglades National Park
about: Dry season (Dec–Apr) is when wildlife concentrates around the shrinking water and mosquitoes are bearable; wet season (Jun–Nov) is hot, buggy, and carries real hurricane risk.
overview: A vast subtropical wetland of sawgrass and mangroves — alligators, manatees, and one of the best birding destinations in the US.
costOverview: Prices stay close to typical national-park levels — the one real add-on is an airboat tour through the sawgrass, which most visitors treat as the signature splurge.

specialSeasons.text: Atlantic hurricane season runs through this whole window — check forecasts before planning a visit.
